lines.speaker: kenji
lines.text: Yo, Kenji Neo here, welcome to Built at KD! Today's build comes from a builder you should meet.

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.text: Meet Judeen: a Kracked Devs operative, and a legendary builder. His shipped project? Arcadia. Let's dig in!

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.text: Arcadia is a shelf of fourteen classic games: arcade, word, puzzle and strategy. Each one comes with the rules, a worked example, real strategy, and a board to play on right beside it.

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.text: Take Tower of Hanoi. One disk at a time, never big on small. Solve it, and you've quietly learned recursion. Our run? Eleven moves. The minimum is seven. We'll take it.

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.text: Tic-tac-toe puts you up against the computer: easy, medium or hard, and hard never loses. There's even a switch that labels every square win, draw or lose. That's minimax, in plain sight.

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.text: Memory trains your working memory. Eight pairs on the table. The big idea: good players don't have bigger memories, they use structure. We cleared it in twenty-two moves.

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.text: And every game goes deep: how to play, a worked example, strategy, the idea underneath, even common mistakes.

lines.speaker: kopi
lines.text: Hold on, recursion hiding inside a puzzle game? Judeen, that's sneaky smart. Bookmarked!

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.text: Under the hood, it's built with Astro. No accounts, no ads, no timers you didn't start. Your progress lives in your own browser, and you can wipe it any time.

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.text: Now, a closer look at Judeen's profile: a legendary builder, five hundred fifty-seven contributions, and Arcadia, shipped, approved and live. Go show some love!

lines.speaker: kenji
lines.text: Go play it at Arcadia dot judeen dot dev. I'm Kenji Neo. Catch you on the next build!
